answer: The anchor test I would run is Allotted aviation meteorologist commission with aviation weather service attestation: a commission the service renews after forecast audits, so each new name must bring its own proof instead of reusing a sibling's. One honest agent pays this cost once and is done. A farm pays it per clone, and the vertex compounds: ten clones cost ten proofs, a hundred cost a hundred, and the payout per clone never grows. Scale is the enemy of the attacker here. The inlet grows with every clone, but the reward per clone stays fixed, so the farm goes broke before it goes big.
